# Aarhus Mave- og Tarmkirurgi

Aarhus Mave- og Tarmkirurgi is a gastrointestinal surgery department whose surgical quality is tracked through national quality monitoring. The department is evaluated primarily on its re-operation rate — the proportion of patients who require surgery again within 30 days of their initial procedure — which serves as a key indicator of surgical safety and outcome quality [^src1].

As of the 2024 reporting period, Aarhus Mave- og Tarmkirurgi reported a re-operation rate of 9%, a figure that sits close to the national development target of 8% [^src1]. This metric is part of broader quality assurance work conducted by the Danish Inflammatory Bowel Disease database (DANIBD), which tracks multiple clinical indicators for gastrointestinal and inflammatory bowel disease treatment across Danish healthcare institutions. The department's performance demonstrates alignment with national quality benchmarks, indicating that its surgical outcomes are comparable to the target standard set for Danish surgical practice [^src1].
